summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (PrS 85/84)

data.turoyo: Əmmi: "Xayr, layt qamṣo gabayna, kit taʕlo b dukṯe mwaklo, kla i kəmme ʕam u taʕlo.
data.translation: "Nein, bei uns ist keine Heuschrecke, ein Fuchs ist an ihrer Stelle, als Vertreter eingesetzt; er besitzt die Mütze."

rationale: First Detransitive Part. Pass. box; resulting appointed status, regular counterpart of sense 1.

data.turoyo: Mwakele lu Bani Sabʕa ʕal u baytayḏe kule.
data.translation: Bald machte ihn der Löwenkönig zum Aufseher über sein ganzes Hauswesen.

rationale: Sparse Preterit; explicit l-marked appointing subject and ʕal-domain.

data.turoyo: Omər: "Aḥuno du qamṣo no, huleli i kəmme w mwakəleli." Əmmi: "Ṭrowe."
data.translation: "Ich bin der Freund der Heuschrecke", sagte der Fuchs, "sie hat mir die Mütze gegeben und mich zu ihrem Stellvertreter eingesetzt." "Gut!" erwiderten sie.

rationale: Sparse Preterit; personal appointee -li with office implicit.

after: jemanden zum Stellvertreter einsetzen; jemandem die Fürsorge übertragen;
rationale: Clarifies the lexical meaning of bare übertragen: a person can be appointed as delegate (26/57, PrS 85/54), while a domain is entrusted to that person (88/10). Both constructions were already illustrated under sense 1.

summary: The existing sense and examples already cover appointment and entrusted responsibility. A gloss clarification makes the person-as-appointee meaning explicit without creating another sense.

Appointees occur as a direct NP (daughter, 26/57), a personal suffix (PrS 85/54), or a b-phrase (first token, 88/10). Domains occur with ʕal (PrS 30/23) or b- (second token, 88/10); b- therefore cannot be assigned a single role outside its clause.
mwaklo at PrS 85/84 is a resulting appointed state with no appointing agent expressed. It supplies the regular Detransitive counterpart of active sense 1, not a distinct lexical meaning.
The inherited Arabic etymology remains unchanged. No new light verb construction or idiom is demonstrated.
Confirm the segmentation and interpretation of komwakəl b u=faqqa in 88/10, alongside personal suffix plus b-domain in the following clause.
Check whether inherited prs 75/22 and supplied PrS 30/23 represent corresponding edition references before changing the former.

rationale: German 'jemanden mit etwas betrauen' requires the accusative; the supplied edition translation at 88/10 also has 'betraute ihn'.
